source: Ontario Ministry of Education — paraphrased expectations for MVP indexing.
note: This is a starter map for Phase 1. Phase 2 will replace it with a fully indexed expectation graph.

language: Identifies letters of the alphabet and their sounds
Recognizes own name and familiar words
Listens to and retells simple stories

reading: Retells beginning, middle, end of a short text
writing: Writes a complete sentence with capital and period

reading: Decodes words with digraphs and blends
Reads grade-2 texts with appropriate fluency
Identifies main idea of a paragraph
writing: Writes a 3–5 sentence paragraph on a topic
math: Tells time to the half hour

reading: Uses context to determine word meaning
writing: Writes a paragraph with a topic and supporting sentences
Edits for capitals, periods, and spelling

reading: Reads grade-level fiction and non-fiction with fluency
Summarizes main ideas and supporting details
writing: Writes a multi-paragraph response with an introduction and conclusion
Writes an opinion piece with reasons and evidence
math: Fraction addition and subtraction with like denominators

reading: Compares texts on the same theme
writing: Writes an organized essay with a clear thesis
